title: security: rbac v2 enforce kms-region-residency + audit logging hardening
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: This PR finishes the RBAC v2 enforcement for KMS region residency and hardens audit logging for KMS-related operations. Motivation: customers in regulated regions require guarantees that keys and encrypted artifacts are provisioned and used only in allowed regions and that all KMS operations are auditable. This change implements an enforcement mode for the existing 'kms-region-residency' policy, adds explicit audit events for KMS access/rotation, and wires policy evaluation into request-time authorization for private and dedicated deployments. Scope: - Add enforced policy checks to the RBAC v2 policy engine and policy controller - Emit structured audit events for KMS operations (Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign/CreateKey/Rotate) with key metadata and region tags - Add migration path: existing tenants on 'audit-only' residency will be notified and given a 2-week opt-in before enforcement is enabled cluster-wide - Add E2E integration test coverage and update infra templates to include KMS residency constraints for private installs What changed (high level): - services/rbacv2/policy_enforcer.go: add enforcement path and granular denial reasons - services/kms/audit_wrapper.go: centralized audit wrapper that emits structured events to the audit-log exporter - pkg/telemetry/audit_schema.md: documented new KMS audit event fields - infra/terraform/kms-residency.tf: validate KMS key region metadata and fail plan if misconfigured in 'enforce' mode - deploy/helm/private/values.yaml: new flag private.kms.residency.enforce (default false for upgrades) - docs/security/rbac-v2.md: upgrade notes and migration steps - tests/integration/rbac_kms_region_test.go: positive and negative cases for region pinning and enforced deny checklist: - [x] implement enforcement path and deny messages - [x] emit audit events for all KMS operations - [x] add integration test coverage - [x] update infra templates and chart values - [x] update docs and release notes Rollout plan: default behavior remains backward compatible: for existing deployments the new flag is off. For new private installs and Dedicated clusters created after 2026-02-18 the residency policy is default-enabled in audit-only mode. Customers will receive an in-console banner 2 weeks before enforced rollout and can opt-out during transition. Related: ENG-4321 (policy engine infra), SEC-211 (audit schema), SUP-1123 (customer request for region lock).

review_comments: Luis Ortega (2026-02-11): Overall looks solid. A few nitpicks: please add unit tests for the deny reason mapping and ensure we do not leak key material in logs.
Maya Chen (2026-02-12): Added unit tests for deny reason mapping and sanitized the audit payloads to avoid key material leakage.
Priya Nair (2026-02-13): Security question: do we sign audit events before sending to exporter for non-Redwood-managed private installs? Might be an integration ask from SRE.

Maya Chen (2026-02-13): Reply: for private installs we emit the structured event and respect the audit_exporter configuration; signing is configurable via private.audit.signing=true and documented in the chart values.

author_replies: Maya Chen (2026-02-14): Fixed the race by serializing the cache refresh and adding a 100ms backoff; added comment and test.
